name: rag-obs
description: Structure-aware RAG over an Obsidian vault, generating study flashcards.

scripts.ollama:pull: ollama pull qwen2.5:14b-instruct && ollama pull nomic-embed-text

curl -sf http://localhost:11434/api/tags > /dev/null || (printf '
